Trusted validation accuracy was 0.76995074, and a fresh-process reload of the persisted model passed, confirming the saved bundle is usable in a new process. No exceptions or crashes occurred.", "metric": 0.76995074, "lower_is_better": false, "code_summary": "Data processing maps ordinal categoricals (age, income, education, time, expiration, frequency) to numeric codes, cleans/coerces types, and engineers features including social_index, matched_venue_freq, distance_level, affinity_ratio, and coupon interaction categoricals. Target encoding with prior smoothing is fit on training rows, using inner-OOF encoding for train rows to avoid leakage, and persisted maps are transformed (never refit) at prediction. Models: CatBoost (native categoricals), LightGBM (numeric TE + ordinal-encoded low-cardinality categoricals), and HistGradientBoosting, all retrained on 100% of training data using iteration counts estimated from 5-fold CV (two seeds). A logistic-regression stacker over OOF logit probabilities produces final predictions, with threshold chosen via inner CV. Predictions are mapped back to original labels and written as row_id,prediction in input order."}
